name: YouthGROW
what_you_do: Teens work on city organic farms in Worcester. They learn to lead, job skills, city farming and fairness. The program has a 6-week summer boost, fall and spring sessions and monthly workshops.
who_can_apply: Worcester teens ages 14 to 18. The page does not list other rules.
pay_detail: Paid. The hourly wage is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Apply by Nov 30, 2026 for the Growing Leaders internship. This round is for ages 14 and 15. Interviews are in December.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form for the Growing Leaders internship by Nov 30, 2026. REC will reach out for an interview in December. Questions: call REC at 508-799-9139.
notes: The open internship is for Worcester youth ages 14 and 15. The pay rate is not stated, so confirm with REC. As of Nov 9, 2026, the Employment page also lists spring hiring for youth mentors. Address: 108 Beacon Street, Worcester. The program employs up to 40 teens year-round.
